# Recorded answers from the India Code REST API

Real responses from https://indiacode.gov.in/server/api for The Army Act, 1950, recorded on
2026-11-21 by `python -m crawler discover --source indiacode --only act-army-1950 --record <dir>`.
`index.json` maps each URL to its file. They are public records from an official site, kept
unmodified so the tests exercise the real data layout. The PDFs themselves are not recorded.
